mechanism: PFV (public-flag value in a writable relational row)

steps.detail: real schema created by galaxy.model.mapping.init; galaxy-data 26.1.2
published-index query returns 0 rows; target world-visible: False. Authorized path to flip this is the owner's publish action via the sharable manager.
UPDATE history SET published=1 (one column; no publish action, no owner)
real ORM reload: History.published=True; published-index query now returns 1 rows; target world-visible: True
EXPOSED — a state-only write to `published` makes the record world-visible through the real model read path, with no publish action, no owner, and no provenance check on the column.
